content.json:
# VM Disk Observability

Start at the **Throttling diagnosis** band to tell at a glance whether throttling is coming from a single disk SKU limit or the VM SKU aggregate. Drill into the detailed trend charts to see when and which LUN, then use the provisioned-limit tables and guest inventory for context. Native Azure VM charts use platform metrics split by LUN; guest metrics come from VM Insights.

parameters.name: Computer
parameters.label: Machines
parameters.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk'
| distinct value = Computer, label = Computer
| order by label asc

parameters.name: Mount
parameters.label: Mounts
parameters.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| distinct value = Mount, label = Mount
| order by label asc

parameters.name: VirtualMachines
parameters.label: Native Azure VM
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| order by name asc
| project value = id, label = name, selected = id =~ '__NATIVE_VM_RESOURCE_ID__'

content.json:
## Throttling diagnosis — disk limit or VM SKU limit?

These four charts show the peak consumed percentage over the selected time range for the selected VM. A series at or above 95% for five consecutive minutes indicates throttling at that scope.

* **A DISK chart reaches ~100%** → an individual data disk hit its own provisioned IOPS or bandwidth limit → resize or upgrade that disk.
* **A VM SKU chart reaches ~100%** → the VM hit its aggregate IOPS or bandwidth limit across all disks → resize the VM.
* **Both high** → the disk is saturating and rolling up to the VM limit too.

Use the detailed trend charts below to see when it happened and which LUN.

_These charts show the peak over the selected time range — the worst moment, not the current state. Narrow the time range to see current activity._

content.title: DISK — IOPS consumed (peak % in window)
DISK — bandwidth consumed (peak % in window)
VM SKU — IOPS consumed (peak % in window)
VM SKU — bandwidth consumed (peak % in window)

## Detailed throttling trends (consumed %)

Per-LUN and cached/uncached breakdowns to pinpoint when throttling occurred and which disk or VM ceiling was involved. Data Disk Latency is a preview metric and requires SCSI-attached disks; it is unavailable for NVMe-attached disks.

content.title: Data disk IOPS consumed by LUN (%) — {VirtualMachines:label}
Data disk bandwidth consumed by LUN (%) — {VirtualMachines:label}
VM IOPS consumed: cached vs uncached (%) — {VirtualMachines:label}
VM bandwidth consumed: cached vs uncached (%) — {VirtualMachines:label}
Data disk latency by LUN (ms) — {VirtualMachines:label}

content.json:
## Provisioned limits (reference)

Provisioned per-disk limits and their sum across all disks, plus the absolute VM SKU maximums. When the summed disk limits exceed the VM SKU maximums, the disks are over-provisioned and the VM throttles first. Series are split by Azure data-disk LUN, not by guest drive letter.

content.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(managedBy) and managedBy contains 'virtualMachines'
| extend VM = tostring(split(managedBy, '/')[-1])
| project VM, DiskName = name, Sku = tostring(sku.name), SizeGiB = toint(properties.diskSizeGB), MaxIOPS = toint(properties.diskIOPSReadWrite), MaxThroughputMBps = toint(properties.diskMBpsReadWrite)
| order by VM asc, MaxIOPS desc
content.title: Provisioned per-disk limits (disk SKU)

content.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(managedBy) and managedBy contains 'virtualMachines'
| extend VM = tostring(split(managedBy, '/')[-1])
| summarize Disks = count(), TotalProvisionedIOPS = sum(toint(properties.diskIOPSReadWrite)), TotalProvisionedThroughputMBps = sum(toint(properties.diskMBpsReadWrite)) by VM
| order by VM asc
content.title: Total provisioned limits across all disks
Data disk IOPS used by LUN (peak, read + write)
Data disk throughput used by LUN (peak, read + write)

content.json:
### VM SKU maximum limits — __VM_SKU_SIZE__

These are the absolute aggregate ceilings published for the VM SKU. The VM cached and uncached consumed % charts below measure activity against them. When the total provisioned disk limits above exceed these numbers, the disks are over-provisioned and the VM throttles first.

| Scope | Max IOPS | Max throughput (MB/s) |
|---|---|---|
| VM uncached (remote data disks) | __VM_SKU_MAX_UNCACHED_IOPS__ | __VM_SKU_MAX_UNCACHED_MBPS__ |
| VM cached (temp disk + host cache) | __VM_SKU_MAX_CACHED_IOPS__ | __VM_SKU_MAX_CACHED_MBPS__ |

Values shown as N/A are not published for this VM series. Uncached limits apply to remotely attached data disks; cached limits add a separate buffer for reads served from the host cache and temp disk.

## Disk read vs write activity (by LUN)

Separate read and write throughput and IOPS for each Azure data-disk LUN, to see the workload read/write mix. Averaged over the selected time range.

content.title: Read throughput by LUN
Write throughput by LUN
Read IOPS by LUN
Write IOPS by LUN

content.json:
## Hybrid disk inventory

This section works for Azure Arc connected servers and native Azure VMs monitored by VM Insights. Values are grouped by guest logical disk or mount, not Azure LUN.

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| extend DiskSizeMB = todouble(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/diskSizeMB'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize AvgIOPS = avgif(Val, Name == 'TransfersPerSecond'), PeakIOPS = maxif(Val, Name == 'TransfersPerSecond'), AvgThroughputMBps = avgif(Val, Name == 'BytesPerSecond') / 1024 / 1024, PeakThroughputMBps = maxif(Val, Name == 'BytesPerSecond') / 1024 / 1024, AvgLatencyMs = avgif(Val, Name == 'TransferLatencyMs'), PeakLatencyMs = maxif(Val, Name == 'TransferLatencyMs'), LowestFreePercent = minif(Val, Name == 'FreeSpacePercentage'), DiskSizeMB = max(DiskSizeMB), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, Mount, _ResourceId
| extend ResourceType = case(_ResourceId has '/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/', 'Azure Arc', _ResourceId has '/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/', 'Azure VM', 'Other')
| extend UsedPercent = 100.0 - LowestFreePercent
| project Computer, ResourceType, Mount, DiskSizeGB = round(DiskSizeMB / 1024, 1), UsedPercent = round(UsedPercent, 1), AvgIOPS = round(AvgIOPS, 1), PeakIOPS = round(PeakIOPS, 1), AvgThroughputMBps = round(AvgThroughputMBps, 2), PeakThroughputMBps = round(PeakThroughputMBps, 2), AvgLatencyMs = round(AvgLatencyMs, 2), PeakLatencyMs = round(PeakLatencyMs, 2), LastSeen, ResourceId = _ResourceId
| order by PeakIOPS desc
content.title: Per-disk performance and capacity

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'TransfersPerSecond'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize IOPS = avg(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Mount
| extend Series = strcat(Computer, ' | ', Mount)
| project TimeGenerated, Series, IOPS
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total IOPS by logical disk

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'BytesPerSecond'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize ThroughputMBps = avg(Val) / 1024 / 1024 by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Mount
| extend Series = strcat(Computer, ' | ', Mount)
| project TimeGenerated, Series, ThroughputMBps
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total throughput by logical disk (MiB/s)

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'TransferLatencyMs'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize LatencyMs = avg(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Mount
| extend Series = strcat(Computer, ' | ', Mount)
| project TimeGenerated, Series, LatencyMs
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Average latency by logical disk (ms)

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'FreeSpacePercentage'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize UsedPercent = 100.0 - avg(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer, Mount
| extend Series = strcat(Computer, ' | ', Mount)
| project TimeGenerated, Series, UsedPercent
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Filesystem capacity used by logical disk (%)

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'TransfersPerSecond'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize MountIOPS = avg(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Mount
| summarize TotalIOPS = sum(MountIOPS) by TimeGenerated, Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Series = Computer, TotalIOPS
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total guest IOPS across all disks by machine

content.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'BytesPerSecond'
| extend Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| where isnotempty(Mount)
| where Mount !startswith '/snap/' and Mount !startswith '/sys/'
| where '*' in ({Computer}) or Computer in ({Computer})
| where '*' in ({Mount}) or Mount in ({Mount})
| summarize MountMBps = avg(Val) / 1024 / 1024 by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Mount
| summarize TotalThroughputMBps = sum(MountMBps) by TimeGenerated, Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Series = Computer, TotalThroughputMBps
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total guest throughput across all disks by machine (MiB/s)
